turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Hi Marcus! How is your Tuesday going over in Portland? How are things at the high school science department?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hey! Things are pretty busy as usual, but going well. I started the morning with a warm bowl of oatmeal to make sure I had enough energy for the day.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Oatmeal is definitely a solid start for a hectic day. Hopefully, the department isn't throwing too many surprises at you this week. How is Grace doing?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Grace is doing great, thanks for asking. I actually managed to sneak away during lunch to get some exercise in with a quick game of tennis.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: That's awesome, a tennis match is a great way to break up a busy workday. By the way, have you two made any more progress on planning your family trip to Japan next spring?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: We have! We've been looking at some train itineraries and checking out places to stay in Tokyo. It's a lot of fun to research.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: It sounds incredibly exciting. Is Olive helping you map out the route, or is she mostly just lounging around?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Mainly lounging around, though she did step on my keyboard a few times while I was trying to look up hotels. She definitely wants to be the center of attention.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Sounds like standard cat behavior! I hope you get some time to just relax tonight after a busy day of teaching, tennis, and trip planning.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: That's the plan. I'm just going to keep it simple tonight and watch some sitcom reruns on TV before heading to bed.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: That sounds like a perfect, cozy evening. There's nothing quite like some comfort TV to wind down. Enjoy your night, Marcus!

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Thanks, I will. Talk to you tomorrow!
